# **Why Join Us**

## Outsourced Pro Global Limited is more than a workplace.

It is a community built on growth, collaboration, and excellence. We believe that our people are the foundation of our success, which is why we create an environment where talent is nurtured, innovation is encouraged, and achievements are celebrated.

## When you join our team,you gain the opportunity to build a meaningful career with global impact.

You will work alongside leading international brands, develop your skills through continuous learning, and thrive within a culture that values integrity, professionalism, and long-term success. This is a place where your ideas matter, your ambitions are supported, and your growth has no limits.

# **Get a glimpse of life at OPG!**

Follow us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/OPGteam/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/_opgteam/), [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@_opgteam?lang=en) and [Linkedin](https://linkedin.com/company/outsourced-pro-global/) to see our vibrant company culture, meet the team, and catch behind-the-scenes moments. From office highlights to team celebrations, discover what it’s like to be part of a community that values growth, connection, and fun.

## Paid Media and Marketing Data Analyst - PH

Remote

Full Time

Marketing Department

Mid Level

[Share](https://outsourcedproglobal.applytojob.com/app/share/OeMDx1W3Rq)

**Benefits:**

- Service Fee: **₱100,000 PHP per month (depending on experience)**
- Location: **Remote** – Philippines
- Job Type: **Full Time \| Day Shift** (Sydney, Australia Time Zone)
- **28 days of paid time off** per year
- **HMO coverage**
- **Performance-based annual incentive**
- Clear path for **career growth and development**

**Essential Requirements**

- **2+ years of experience** in marketing analytics, reporting, or data analysis.
- Experience with **HubSpot**, particularly for dashboard creation and reporting.
- Strong understanding of **paid media channels and performance metrics**.
- Ability to **translate data insights into clear recommendations for non-technical stakeholders**.
- Willing to work with **Zoom Camera ON for 8 hours** and undergo a **background check**.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented **Paid Media & Marketing Data Analyst** to join our marketing team. This role will focus on crunching numbers, building actionable reports, and providing insights across marketing channels, primarily paid media - while also supporting ad hoc reporting for other marketing initiatives like organic campaigns, social content calendars, and performance tracking.

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

- Build, maintain, and automate daily, weekly, and monthly performance reports for all paid media campaigns ( **Meta, Google, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok**).
- Develop ad hoc reports for other marketing channels, including **organic social, email, and content marketing** initiatives.
- Maintain data integrity across multiple dashboards and reporting platforms ( **HubSpot, Google Analytics, Data Studio**, etc.).
- Translate complex data into clear, digestible insights for non-technical stakeholders.
- Monitor campaign performance daily and highlight trends, anomalies, and optimisation opportunities.
- Collaborate with the marketing team to support campaign planning and forecasting.
- Assist with social media and content calendars by providing performance insights and recommendations.

**Key Skills:**

- Advanced skills in **Excel/Google Sheets**
- Experience with other dashboards ( **Google Data Studio, Looker Studio**, or similar).
- Comfortable working with large datasets, analyzing trends, and drawing insights.
- Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, and ability to manage multiple reporting projects simultaneously.
- Proficient in English
- Bonus: Experience in the **property, finance, or performance marketing industries**.

**Qualifications:**

- **Bachelor's degree** in Marketing, Data Science, or related field.
- **Familiarity with multiple dashboards** such as Google Analytics, and Data Studio.
- Extensive experience with **CRM systems** and marketing platforms

**Technical Requirements:**

- Windows 11 operating system or MacOS 14+
- 256GB Storage space - minimum
- 16GB RAM - minimum
- Dual Core CPU - minimum
- Camera: HD Webcam (720p)
- Headset: Noise canceling (preferably)
- Internet Speed: 50 Mbps - minimum

**About Us**

Outsourced Pro Global Limited is a trusted outsourcing partner supporting businesses in recruitment, finance, HR, payroll, and operations. As the offshore hub for leading Australian companies, we deliver high-quality, efficient solutions through a team driven by integrity, excellence, and innovation.

At OPG, you’ll be part of a collaborative, growth-focused community. We offer meaningful careers, global exposure, and a culture that values learning, professionalism, and long-term success. Your ideas matter, your growth is supported, and your impact is real.

Curious about life at OPG?

Follow us on [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/OPGteam/), [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/opgteam_/), [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@_opgteam?lang=en) and [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/company/outsourced-pro-global/) for a peek into our culture, team moments, and what makes OPG a great place to work.
